Guidelines

  • Product name: SprintSpaces, written as one word with both S letters capitalized.
  • Logo mark: a blue rounded square with three white lines; the last line is shorter.
  • On light backgrounds, use the blue mark and navy wordmark. On dark backgrounds, use the white mark and white wordmark.
  • Keep the original proportions. Minimum mark size: 24 px. Clear space: at least ¼ of the mark’s width.
  • Font: system sans-serif; for email, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif.
  • Buttons: blue #0C66E4 with white text. Main text #172B4D, secondary text #626F86, borders #DCDFE4.

In correspondence

Use the PNG wordmark at about 220 × 45 px, with “SprintSpaces” as the alternative text. SVG is not reliable across all email clients. Sender name: “SprintSpaces”. Product footer: “SprintSpaces — space for good work”.
